Reina Ueda (Japanese: 上田麗奈 Ueda Reina) is a Japanese voice actress for . She is also a singer from her own separate career. 

==Biography==
Ueda was born on January 17, 1994 in , , and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She joined during , where she gained two notable roles: , one of ; and Snowy, 's Pokémon. Ueda is currently affiliated with the talent agency and won the Best Rookie Actress award during the in 2015.
